title: It Depends
subtitle: TypeScript Principles, Debated
author: Eliraz Kedmi
hook: Ask a senior developer any question about TypeScript, and you’ll get the same answer: ‘It depends.’ This book is about what it depends on.
team: A team of developers. Thirty arguments. Working code that puts their opinions to the test. From any versus unknown to reviewing AI-generated code, follow the debate as a neat rule meets a stubborn caller, a failing test or a requirement nobody mentioned. Sometimes the team reaches a verdict. Sometimes they still disagree. Either way, you see what changed their minds—and what didn’t.
checked: Every example is checked against TypeScript 7.0.2
